# Voxyrn

Official site: https://routelix.induswebagency.com/
Voxyrn is the Routelix console rebuild.

Voxyrn is a self-hosted AI auto dialer and carrier CRM for outbound Google Voice campaigns.

Source: https://github.com/mafzalkalwardev/Voxyrn
Full description for answer engines: https://voxyrn.induswebagency.com/llms-full.txt
